results.description:
He may have found her.

But she already lost everything…

Eleven years of him being right there, and I was the only person in Sea Salt Bay who didn’t see it…

For over a decade, Tom Darcy has kept his true feelings for Nina Ellis hidden. Now Tom's ex, Cara, has arrived in Sea Salt Bay, offering Tom the future he's always dreamed of. One that would mean leaving Nina behind.

Nina likes Cara. Can see exactly why Tom lights up around her. So why does the thought of him moving away leave her feeling so unsettled?

As buried feelings rise to the surface, Tom and Nina must ask themselves if they are finally ready to be honest – with each other, and themselves…

Tropes:
Grief and lost loveFinding love againSecond chancesSmall-town romance
Carry Me Home is the final book in a 3-book series delivering romantic escape with real-world grit, but can be read as a standalone.

About the author

Anna Bloom writes emotionally immersive women’s fiction with romantic depth and a strong sense of place. Her work explores themes of identity, belonging, and healing through love. Based in the UK, she draws inspiration from real coastal villages and the complexities of modern womanhood.
